 Lens vs Como: Recent results
 Lens have won two and lost three of their last five competitive matches, with no draws. They most recently lost 1-0 at home to Lille in Ligue 1. Before that came a 3-0 against Club Brugge in the Champions League, while wins over Paris FC (2-1) and Troyes (3-1 away) offered encouragement. Across those five matches, Lens scored eight goals and conceded six.
 Como have shown form previously unseen for a promoted side, winning five matches out of five without a draw or defeat. Their latest success was a 1-0 win over Venezia, preceded by a 3-1 win in Turin and a 4-1 Champions League victory over Manchester United. Como scored 11 goals and conceded just two across those five matches.
